findings.description: Direct inspection of V28 sit and crouch renders still shows extensive shorts over the raised thighs. The added center-crossing front-lap geometry creates an overlap at the hem but the overskirt panels remain beside and behind the lifted legs rather than forming continuous lap coverage.

Direct inspection of front, three-quarter, and side views shows coarse triangular faceting, uneven hem edges, and stacked/protruding hem corners. The front-lap overlap does not repair the broad surface and transition defects.
The back view still does not show a distinct readable rear adjustment tab or buckle.
Authored UV mapping is missing. The automatic prototype unwrap is not authored UV evidence and no inspected image constitutes a UV layout.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V28 changed both front-lap pattern pieces from a center seam to unfastened edges that overlap by 80 mm per side at the hem, with a 4 mm exclusive radial offset on the left piece. Direct inspection of all five views and six poses confirms that shorts remain broadly exposed in sit and crouch, skirt faceting and hem irregularity persist, the rear tab remains illegible, and authored UV mapping remains missing. The trial is rejected and does not establish fit, shape-key, runtime or release acceptance.

nextAction: Reject V28 and stop increasing center overlap or changing weights alone. The front-lap panel coordinate system/attachment is not mapping the overlap onto raised thighs. Next, inspect native sewn-mesh vertex trajectories and posed thigh coordinate frames, then implement a pose-aware geometry transfer or revised panel attachment that carries the lap across each raised thigh. Independently smooth/refine the skirt topology, add a distinct rear tab/buckle, and author panel UVs. Re-render all five views and six poses for direct review. Fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat execution, packaging and release remain unverified.
